provenance.generatedBy: Procedural Blender 5.0.1 authoring via blender --background (build_rifleman.py). No image-to-3D generator locally; Qwen Image 2.1 through ComfyUI is concept images only.
provenance.notes: Original design inspired by the reference silhouette (squat armoured infantry, domed helmet, visor slit, backpack, short rifle). Not generated from the image; reference untouched. Previous 2D blockout + sprite sheet archived under art/archive/2d-sprite-prototype-2026-09-26/.

rig.convention: Blender Z-up, origin at feet, facing -Y; down-limbs rolled -90 so local +Y pitches forward. glTF export +Y up: Godot sees forward -Z, feet y=0.

visualRoundtrip: Vision review of GLB roundtrip: rifle held forward, walk stride readable, backpack correct, no detached/intersecting geometry. Blocky low-poly style; upgrade path is a subdivision/sculpt pass.
